preconditions.expression: q == int(stdin.split()[0]) and q >= 1 and q <= 10**3
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 10³) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(a) <= (2**25 - 1) for a in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the q subsequent lines contains an integer a_i (2 ≤ a_i ≤ 2²⁵ - 1) for which the function f(a_i) must be computed.

postconditions.description: For each integer a_i in the input, the output must contain the maximum value of gcd(a_i ⊕ b, a_i & b) for some integer b in the range 1 ≤ b < a_i, printed in the same order as the input integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 < int(result) <= int(a) for a, result in zip(stdin.split()[1:], stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: The result for each a_i must be a positive integer not exceeding a_i, representing the maximum GCD achievable.
